title: Steven Greenstreet's one-night visit

tellings.quote: >> one night. He spent one night on the ranch, and he came in obviously with confirmation bias.

plain: A reporter named Steven Greenstreet spent just one night at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange happenings, and arrived already sure of what he would find. That is the account of Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, who says Greenstreet "came in obviously with confirmation bias." Fugal raises it to argue that Greenstreet's doubts about the ranch are not worth much.
